findings.title: Queries are interpolated twice in the sharding path
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery now calls applyTemplateVariables on each target and then passes the subrequests to runSplitQuery, which calls applyTemplateVariables again on every subrequest. The test confirms this: the call count goes from 1 to 5. Running interpolation a second time on already-interpolated expressions can double-apply ad-hoc filters (request.filters) or re-escape values. It also adds per-shard overhead.
